diagrams.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: premium vector-style architecture diagram for technical documentation, wide landscape 3:2, high resolution.
Primary request: Explain the Moovha Wallet Provider Kit's actual responsibility boundary with precise labelled nodes and directed connections. This must be an INFORMATIONAL DIAGRAM, not an editorial illustration or mockup.
Visual language: exquisite Figma-quality vector design, Swiss information design, razor-sharp flat shapes, thin consistent connector strokes, rounded rectangular cards, disciplined modular grid, abundant white space, elegant restrained cyan accents, subtle pale blue grouping panels. White background, deep navy #0f2338 labels, cyan #12bfde flow accents. Tiny monochrome line icons only. No people scenes, no desks, no safes, no 3D, no photographic texture, no decorative objects. Large highly legible typography; no title paragraph.
Exact diagram content and layout:
At left outside the boundary, two separate cards stacked: "Account owner" at top, "Connected application" below.
At right, one large softly tinted rounded boundary labelled "Your wallet service".
Inside this boundary: "Host authority" above; "Wallet Provider Kit" at centre; "Wallet backend" to the right. A small key line icon appears INSIDE the Wallet backend card.
Draw only these directed connections, with their exact short labels:
Account owner → Host authority: "Consent + approval"
Connected application → Wallet Provider Kit: "Authenticated request"
Wallet Provider Kit → Host authority: "Check current permission"
Wallet Provider Kit → Wallet backend: "Approved action only"
Wallet Provider Kit → Connected application: "Permitted result"
Use separate parallel lanes for request and returned result; route connections cleanly with no overlap or crossing labels.
One understated footer annotation: "Backend determines key control and recovery".
Constraints: Preserve all wording exactly. Authority and backend are distinct. No key is sent to the application. No blockchain settlement or automatic sponsorship claim. Make it visually stunning through hierarchy, alignment and clarity, never decorative clutter.
